about: Sushi and Japanese restaurant foods under the names people order them. Each copies one USDA food (mostly FNDDS, which gives sushi as eaten) or is a recipe of USDA foods; the basis names them. See README.md.

foods.name: California roll (sushi)
foods.basis: USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2708961: "Sushi roll, California". USDA has no analysis per roll; FNDDS gives the roll as eaten (rice, nori and filling) per 100 g, with its pieces as servings.

foods.name: Sushi rice (seasoned)
foods.basis: Recipe: USDA SR Legacy 168932: "Rice, white, short-grain, cooked, unenriched" 300 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2709351: "Vinegar" 30 g; USDA SR Legacy 169655: "Sugars, granulated" 12 g; USDA SR Legacy 173468: "Salt, table" 4 g. Short-grain white rice seasoned with rice vinegar, sugar and salt (about 2 Tbsp vinegar, 1 Tbsp sugar and 3/4 tsp salt per 2 cups cooked rice). A typical recipe written by NutriMe, not a measured dish; the nutrients are the USDA values of the ingredients. FNDDS "Vinegar" stands in for rice vinegar.

foods.name: Ahi tuna poke bowl
foods.basis: Recipe: USDA SR Legacy 175159: "Fish, tuna, fresh, yellowfin, raw" 100 g; USDA SR Legacy 168932: "Rice, white, short-grain, cooked, unenriched" 200 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2709223: "Avocado, raw" 50 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2707436: "Edamame, cooked" 30 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2709784: "Cucumber, raw" 30 g; USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 2707442: "Soy sauce" 15 g. Raw yellowfin tuna on short-grain rice with avocado, edamame, cucumber and soy sauce. A typical recipe written by NutriMe, not a measured dish; the nutrients are the USDA values of the ingredients. Sauces such as spicy mayo are not included; log them separately.
